channel.title: locus-x64 · security research notes
channel.description: Vulnerability research, exploit development and reverse engineering notes by Ali Raza (locus-x64).

item.title: CVE-2026-82522: Phantom Box Injection in libjxl's Container Parser on 32-bit Platforms
item.description: A 64-to-32 bit integer truncation in libjxl's container box parser lets an attacker shift box boundaries on 32-bit builds, making the decoder parse attacker-controlled codestream bytes as phantom box headers and inject arbitrary Exif/XMP metadata.

item.title: Call of the Death: An N-Day Walk Through a Samsung Baseband Heap Overflow (CVE-2020-25279)
item.description: Reversing a Samsung Exynos (Shannon) baseband firmware to independently locate CVE-2020-25279, a missing Bearer Capability length check in the SETUP message parser that lets an oversized buffer be allocated and later overflow.

item.title: Process Hijacking via pidfd: Stealing File Descriptors for Post-Exploitation Shells
item.description: A technique for stealing file descriptors across process boundaries using Linux pidfd syscalls for post-exploitation shells on Android.

item.title: CVE-2025-61765: RCE in Socket.IO via Pickle Deserialization
item.description: A Remote Code Execution vulnerability in python-socketio affecting multi-server deployments using message brokers. Caused by insecure deserialization where the library blindly unpickles data from shared message channels.

item.title: Elixir Cross Referencer: Indexing and Auditing Source Code
item.description: Explore source code in your browser - Particularly useful for the Linux kernel and other low-level projects in C/C++. A guide to setting up your own Elixir instance.

item.title: CVE-2024-22857: Arbitrary Code Execution in zlog
item.description: Heap-based buffer overflow in zlog versions 1.1.0 to 1.2.17 in zlog_rule_new(). An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to overwrite the zlog_record_fn record_func function pointer to achieve arbitrary code execution.

item.title: Linux Kernel Compilation and Adding a Custom System Call
item.description: We can make changes to the Linux kernel and compile it to make a custom copy. Learn how to compile a kernel, add a custom system call, write a wrapper function, and create a man page.
